correctness.rationale: Every ternary order-five de Bruijn cycle contains 00000, which has symbol-pair discrepancy five and gives an unconditional lower bound. Pinned witness.txt has exactly 243 symbols, 81 per symbol and 243 distinct cyclic five-windows; those exhaust all ternary five-words. Its prefix-height extrema for pairs (0,1),(0,2),(1,2) are respectively (−4,1),(−4,1),(−2,3), width five each. Equality of global symbol frequencies makes every wrapping interval's imbalance the negative of its complementary interval, so all 243² circular factors have pair discrepancy ≤5. The independent exhaustive direct scanner confirms every cyclic interval. The matching lower and upper bounds prove the exact finite optimum; no assumption of an unsearched optimization routine is needed.

A complete 243-symbol certificate closing this one-unit gap resolves a concrete unfilled natural invariant that can serve as a sharp benchmark for future low-discrepancy de Bruijn constructions. No general new theorem is asserted or required for this finite exact answer.

limitations: Finite exact certificate only for q=3 order n=5.
